column1: # ALLOC-CLASSES.tsv -- the class of every allocation site, every class-bearing free and every root of the oracle's window sources as rtt -x translates them for Config linux and Graphics 1 (skill icon reference.md section 9, THE WINDOW FACILITY, W1; officer_07 2026-11-16 from the cio's ICON-GRAPHICS-ALLOC-SITES.tsv of 2026-11-10, its six WinExtns rows dropped as not built and rcolor.r 585 added). util_gen_icon_xwin_device.py reads it, converts each site to the macro XWIN_<class>_<call> of xwin_alloc.h, and refuses rc 2 a site of the translated C that no row names and a row that names no site.

# classes: RECORD a record of a chain, an HB_LREC block with its layout, by GRFX_ALLOC or one malloc of a record struct; HELD a buffer or name a record field keeps, an HB_RVEC block; PTRS an array of heap pointers a record keeps, an HB_LREC block whose layout marks every word; ROOTED a buffer a file-scope root keeps across calls, an HB_RVEC block; CALLEXT allocated in a helper and released by its caller inside one window function (and its free stores NULL), an HB_RVEC block; SCRATCH allocated and freed inside one function, its machine stack.

# rows: site <tab> source <tab> line <tab> call <tab> assigned to <tab> class <tab> why   (a RECORD row of GRFX_ALLOC names its struct tag in the call column as GRFX_ALLOC:<tag>; line is the use line)
# rows: root <tab> source <tab> - <tab> ptr|descr <tab> name <tab> ROOT <tab> why

# gf_paltbl, the second palette pointer of the 2026-11-10 count, is no root: a static of rimage.r of call extent, its block reached after the read through the caller's imgdata (a record's layout or the function's own frame), and nothing moves inside one window function
# every free of the sources becomes nothing (XWIN_FREE) except a free a CALLEXT row names, which stores NULL (XWIN_FREE_NULL)
